name: Chest Press
aliases: chest press machine, seated chest press, machine press
instructions: Set the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest.
Keep your back and head against the pad.
Push the handles forward until your arms are almost straight, without locking the elbows.
Bring them back slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.

name: Barbell Bench Press
aliases: bench press, flat bench, bb bench
instructions: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar a little wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar with control to the middle of your chest.
Press it back up over your shoulders.
Use a spotter or safety bars when lifting heavy.

name: Incline Chest Press
aliases: incline press machine, incline machine press
instructions: Set the seat so the handles start at upper-chest height.
Keep your back against the pad.
Press up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly to the starting position.

name: Pec Deck
aliases: pec fly, chest fly machine, butterfly
instructions: Set the seat so the handles are at chest height.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows throughout.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a stretch, not pain, in the chest.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Set both pulleys at shoulder height or above and take one handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance with a slight lean.
With elbows slightly bent, bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Return slowly, keeping the same elbow angle.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Keep your feet flat and shoulder blades pulled back.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower them with control to the sides of your chest.

name: Push-up
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands a little wider than shoulder width.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest towards the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Push back up. Do them with knees on the floor to make it easier.

name: Lat Pulldown
aliases: lat pull down, pulldown, lat machine
instructions: Adjust the knee pad so your legs are held in place.
Grip the bar a little wider than shoulder width.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, leading with your elbows.
Let it rise slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Seated Cable Row
aliases: cable row, seated row, low row
instructions: Sit with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Keep your back straight and chest up.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Chest-Supported Row Machine
aliases: machine row, t-bar row machine, row machine
instructions: Set the seat so your chest rests on the pad and you can reach the handles.
Pull the handles back, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Keep your chest on the pad the whole time.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Assisted Pull-up Machine
aliases: assisted pull up, gravitron, assisted chin up
instructions: Choose the counterweight: more weight means more help.
Kneel or stand on the platform and grip the handles.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above your hands.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Dumbbell Row
aliases: one arm row, db row, single arm dumbbell row
instructions: Put one hand and one knee on a bench, back flat.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand with the arm straight.
Pull the dumbbell towards your hip, keeping the elbow close to your body.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Hang from the bar with hands a little wider than shoulder width, palms facing away.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Use a resistance band or the assisted machine if you can't do a full rep yet.

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Lie under a bar set at about waist height and grip it with straight arms.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Pull your chest up to the bar.
Lower slowly. Bend your knees to make it easier.

name: Shoulder Press Machine
aliases: machine shoulder press, overhead press machine
instructions: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
Keep your back against the pad.
Press the handles up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height.

name: Lateral Raise Machine
aliases: machine lateral raise, side raise machine
instructions: Set the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine's pivot.
Place your arms against the pads.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
aliases: rear delt fly machine, reverse fly
instructions: Sit facing the machine with your chest against the pad.
Hold the handles with arms straight in front of you, elbows slightly bent.
Move your arms out and back until they're in line with your body.
Return slowly.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
aliases: db shoulder press, seated dumbbell press
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are almost straight.
Keep your lower back against the bench.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
With a slight bend in the elbows, raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Avoid swinging your body.
Lower slowly.

name: Pike Push-up
instructions: Start in a push-up position, then walk your feet in and lift your hips so your body forms an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head towards the floor.
Push back up.
Elevate your hands or reduce the range to make it easier.

name: Leg Press
aliases: leg press machine, 45 degree leg press
instructions: Sit with your back flat against the pad and feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform until your knees are at about 90 degrees, keeping your lower back on the pad.
Push back up without locking your knees, then put the safety handles back on when done.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Set the back pad so your knees line up with the machine's pivot.
Put the ankle pad just above your feet.
Straighten your legs to lift the pad.
Lower slowly.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Stand on the platform with your back and shoulders against the pads, feet shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety handles.
Bend your knees to lower yourself until your thighs are about parallel to the platform.
Push back up through your whole foot.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Rest the bar on your upper back, not your neck, and stand with feet about shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Bend your hips and knees to sit down as low as you can with good form.
Stand back up, pushing through your whole foot.
Use a squat rack with safety bars.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet a little wider than shoulder width.
Squat down between your knees, keeping your chest up.
Stand back up.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart, arms in front for balance.
Sit your hips back and down, keeping your chest up.
Go as low as is comfortable.
Stand back up.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Set the back pad so your knees line up with the machine's pivot.
Put the lower pad just above your heels and lock the thigh pad.
Bend your knees to pull the pad down and back.
Return slowly.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down with your knees just past the end of the bench.
Put the pad just above your heels.
Bend your knees to bring the pad towards your glutes.
Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
With a slight bend in the knees, push your hips back and lower the dumbbells along your legs.
Keep your back flat; stop when you feel a stretch in the back of your legs.
Drive your hips forward to stand up.

name: Single-leg Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Hinge at the hips, letting the other leg rise behind you, back flat.
Lower until your body is close to horizontal or you feel a stretch.
Return to standing. Hold onto something for balance if needed.

name: Hip Thrust Machine
instructions: Sit with your upper back against the pad and the belt or pad across your hips.
Feet flat, about shoulder-width apart.
Push through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and the pads on the outside of your knees.
Push your knees out against the pads.
Return slowly.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell on your hips, held with both hands.
Feet flat, knees bent.
Push through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Push through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pad on your thighs.
Lower your heels as far as is comfortable.
Push up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower slowly.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step, holding something for balance.
Lower your heels below the step.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower slowly.

name: Biceps Curl Machine
instructions: Set the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grip the handles with your palms up.
Curl the handles up by bending your elbows.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Stand facing a low pulley holding a bar or handle with palms up.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the handle up towards your shoulders.
Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Chin-up
instructions: Hang from the bar with hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing you.
Pull yourself up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Use a resistance band or the assisted machine if needed.

name: Triceps Pushdown
aliases: cable pushdown, rope pushdown, tricep pushdown
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley holding a bar or rope.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Push the handle down until your arms are straight.
Let it rise slowly until your forearms are about parallel to the floor.

name: Triceps Dip Machine
instructions: Sit with your back against the pad and grip the handles at your sides.
Push the handles down until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Sit or stand holding one dumbbell with both hands above your head.
Keep your upper arms close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Straighten your arms to lift it back up.

name: Bench Dip
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with hands next to your hips, then slide off so your weight is on your hands.
Bend your elbows to lower your body, keeping your back close to the bench.
Push back up.
Bend your knees more to make it easier. Skip it if it hurts your shoulders.

name: Ab Crunch Machine
instructions: Set the seat and hold the handles or pads.
Curl your upper body forward by tightening your abs.
Return slowly.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel facing a high pulley holding a rope beside your head.
Curl your upper body down towards your knees using your abs, not your arms.
Return slowly.

name: Plank
instructions: Rest on your forearms and toes, elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your core and breathe steadily.
Hold for the time you choose. Put your knees down to make it easier.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back with arms pointing up and knees bent at 90 degrees above your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Slowly lower the opposite arm and leg towards the floor.
Return and switch sides.
